title: Urgent Care vs ER When to Choose Each in Palm Beach County
author: primary-urgent-care

body.raw:
## When to Choose Urgent Care

- Minor fractures, sprains, cuts, infections  
- Flu, strep, COVID testing  
- X-ray, labs, EKG on site

## When to Choose the ER

1. Chest pain or stroke symptoms  
2. Severe breathing trouble  
3. Uncontrolled bleeding

See our [appointment page](/appointment) or find a nearby [location](/locations).
